reader_summary.headline: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard sheds some light on themes from his most recent memo.
reader_summary.overview: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard sheds some light on themes from his most recent memo. Here he is discussing Bull Market Rhymes with Oak Tree Senior Financial Writer, Anna Schimansky. Howard, you use a lot of great quotes in this memo.

key_points.text: I thought we'd start with the one that opens the memo.

key_points.text: History doesn't repeat itself, but it does rhyme.
